metadata.title: प्रद्योत किशोर माणिक्य पर पाताल कन्या का हमला | Pataal Kanya attacks Pradyot Kishor Manikya Debbarma
metadata.description: On the cusp of the Tripura East elections, Vice President Pataal Kanya's critique of Pradyot Kishor Manikya resonates strongly. She warns against the divisive rhetoric that could potentially sour the communal harmony among tribal communities, casting a shadow over Kirti Singh Debbarma's electoral aspirations.
